name: Archaeological Site of Nalanda Mahavihara at Nalanda, Bihar
description: Nalanda is a ruined Buddhist monastery in Bihar, in northeast India, about 90 km southeast of Patna. For centuries it was a famous centre of learning, drawing scholars and pilgrims from across Asia. Today you can walk among rows of red-brick monks' cells, temple foundations and towering stupas, with traces of carved stucco and stone still visible.
